actors.name: Warehouse Operator
actors.description: Manages order shipments from the warehouse

businessGoals.name: Reliable Shipping
businessGoals.description: Ensure orders are shipped correctly and on time

domainConcepts.name: Shipment
domainConcepts.description: A package sent to the customer containing ordered items

domainConcepts.name: Tracking Number
domainConcepts.description: Unique identifier from the carrier for tracking a shipment

domainConcepts.name: Shipping Address
domainConcepts.description: Destination where the shipment is delivered

rules.description: A shipment can only be created for a submitted order
A shipment can only be dispatched if it has a tracking number assigned
A delivered shipment cannot be dispatched again
Shipping address must have street, city, and postal code

buildingBlocks.name: Shipment
buildingBlocks.description: Aggregate root managing the lifecycle of a shipment. Contains ShippingAddress value object.

behaviours.name: createForOrder
behaviours.description: Creates a new shipment for a submitted order

behaviours.name: assignTrackingNumber
behaviours.description: Assigns a carrier tracking number to the shipment

buildingBlocks.name: ShipmentCreated
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a new shipment is created for an order

buildingBlocks.name: ShipmentDispatched
buildingBlocks.description: Emitted when a shipment is dispatched from warehouse

buildingBlocks.name: ShipmentRepository
buildingBlocks.description: Repository for persisting and retrieving Shipment aggregates

behaviours.name: findById
behaviours.description: Finds a shipment by its id

buildingBlocks.name: ShipmentStatus
buildingBlocks.description: Enum representing shipment lifecycle: Created, Dispatched, Delivered

useCases.name: Create Shipment
useCases.description: Creates a shipment for a submitted order

scenarios.name: Successful shipment creation
scenarios.description: Operator creates a shipment for a submitted order
scenarios.given: A submitted order exists with a valid shipping address
scenarios.then: Shipment is created and ShipmentCreated event is emitted

useCases.name: Dispatch Shipment
useCases.description: Dispatches a shipment with tracking number

scenarios.name: Successful dispatch
scenarios.description: Shipment with tracking number is dispatched
scenarios.given: A shipment with an assigned tracking number
scenarios.then: Shipment status changes to Dispatched and ShipmentDispatched event is emitted

scenarios.name: Dispatch without tracking fails
scenarios.given: A shipment without a tracking number
